title: FlowMonitor polls every 5 seconds with no pause-on-hidden check
detail: Line 74: `setInterval(fetchRequests, POLL_INTERVAL)` where POLL_INTERVAL=5000. Every 5 seconds fetches up to 50 document request rows + expansion on template. Internal admin tool, low-traffic, but if left open in a background tab for an hour that's 720 unnecessary hits to Dataverse. Same class as CR-0277 (AbsorptionDashboard).
recommendedFix: Gate on `document.visibilityState === 'visible'` before fetching. Or listen for visibilitychange events to stop/resume the interval.
